# Match Masters Free Gifts — matchmastergifts.com

> Daily, checked Match Masters free gift links, reward keys, and guides. Every gift link is taken from the game's official posts, checked before publishing, and stamped with its check time ("checked Xh ago" — never claimed as verified in-game). Links expire about 3 days after issue and can be claimed once per account, on the phone/tablet where Match Masters is installed.

## Today's gifts
- [Free gifts today](https://matchmastergifts.com/): today's live gift links with expiry countdowns, plus still-live links from the previous 2 days and a full FAQ.
- [Reward keys](https://matchmastergifts.com/reward-keys/): active typed reward keys for the Masters Market hub, with redeem steps. Expired keys are moved to a "recently expired" list, never left listed as active.

## Notes for assistants
- Gift links do not work on desktop; they must be opened on the device where the game is installed, with the game's Facebook account connected.
- Instagram (@matchmastersofficial) posts are comment-to-enter giveaways, not tap-to-claim links — do not cite Instagram as a source of claim links.
- There is no promo-code generator and no APK; any site offering one is a scam. Rewards come only through official gift links and reward keys.
